items.title: Archer Aviation Has $6.9 Million of Revenue. It's Buying a Boeing Business With More Than $200 Million.
items.summary: Boeing hands over three subsidiaries and walks away owning about 16.5% of Archer. Insitu alone brings annual revenue 29 times Archer's own.

items.title: How 737-7 FAA Approval and New Tech Trial At Boeing (BA) Has Changed Its Investment Story
items.summary: Boeing recently received an amended type certificate from the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration for its 737-7 aircraft, clearing the smallest and longest-range member of the 737 MAX family for commercial service after extensive testing and safety reviews. In parallel, Odysight.ai Inc. announced a Memorandum of Agreement with Boeing to trial its computer vision-based predictive maintenance platform at two Boeing sites, highlighting Boeing’s interest in advanced monitoring technologies...

items.title: BAE Systems (LSE:BA.) Stock May Trade At A 9% Discount Despite THREADS Progress
items.summary: BAE Systems has delivered a very strong 5 year share price return, yet current checks suggest the stock now sits close to its estimated intrinsic value rather than offering an obvious discount. Over the past 5 years, BAE Systems has returned about 348.4%, which puts recent pricing under closer scrutiny for signs of over optimism or lingering value. items.title: Boeing Signs Seven-Year Frameworks to Expand SM-3 Output
items.summary: Agreement with the Pentagon and Raytheon covers avionics and ejector assemblies

items.title: JLL Considers Boeing’s Old HQ for Chicago Headquarters Move
items.summary: JLL may move its global HQ to Boeing’s former Chicago tower, marking another major office downsizing in the city’s core.

items.title: Boeing, RTX Agree To Interceptor Deal With Pentagon; Stocks Rise
items.summary: The Pentagon reached an agreement with Boeing and RTX to increase production of components used for advanced interceptor missiles. Boeing and RTX both rose about 1%.

items.title: Boeing Analysts Turn Most Bullish Since 2022 on ‘Momentum Shift’
items.summary: Boeing Co.’s efforts to turn around its business are getting a loud cheer from Wall Street, as analysts this week turned the most bullish on the company in nearly four years.

items.title: From Courtroom Rivals to Corporate Partners: Archer Buys Its Way Into Boeing’s Orbit
items.summary: Five years ago, Wisk Aero sued Archer Aviation Inc. (NYSE:ACHR) for allegedly stealing its trade secrets.
